correctness.rationale: Cycle independence-complex homotopy types are classical, implying simply connectedness for all n>=8. Fixed-face orbit analysis proves gcd(n,a)>1 iff a rotation fixes a point. Every reflection has an invariant independent vertex or two-vertex face. Armstrong computes fundamental groups as the group modulo these stabilizers. For prime p>=11 a free action on an odd-dimensional homotopy sphere gives a two-row integral Serre spectral sequence; finite dimensionality forces a unit transgression to u^m, determining the cohomology ring and integral homology. Exact signed cell computations for p=11,13,17 check the predicted groups, not the infinite proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The published bidirected multipath theorem has a comparable prime-power π1 pattern but acts on directed acyclic path arc sets rather than independent cycle vertices. Cycle nonmatching is a different complex. The general Armstrong theorem proves an orbit group from stabilizers, but it does not provide the explicit stabilizer classification on Ind(C_n); that calculation is supplied here.
